description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetBlank, which adds target="_blank" to outbound links in HTML content during attribute transformation. It utilizes an internal URI parser to analyze links and determine whether to modify link attributes based on schemes and trustworthiness.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetBlank
classes.description: Class responsible for adding target="_blank" attribute to outbound links during HTML attribute transformation, ensuring links do not execute malicious scripts and follow proper schemes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the URI parser instance.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the 'href' attribute of a link; adds 'target="_blank"' if the link is outbound and deemed safe.
